1
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the July 25, 2005/Sravana 3, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Culture; Development of North-Eastern Region; Heavy Industries
and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Parliamentary Affairs; Social
Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban Development;
Urban Employment and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions —20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Ban on smoking scenes in films
*1. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI PRAMOD MAHAJAN:
Will the Minister of
INFORMATION   AND   BROAD -
CASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Health Minister's
directive to ban smoking scenes in
movies and advertisements has been
considered by his Ministry;
(b) whether Government have issued
any instructions to strictly follow the
above directive in TV serials and films
including foreign channels and films;
(c) if not, the reasons and
justification therefor;
(d) whether the above directive to
black-out tobacco scenes is unworkable
and it has also been opposed by the Film
Industry; and
(e) if so, th e alternative measures
being considered by Government in this
regard?
Utilization of funds under Sarva
Shiksha Abhiyan
*2. SHRI S. S. AHLUWALIA: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the funds allocated
annually for implementation of Sarva
Shiksha Abhiyan since its inception, State-
wise and year-wise;
(b) the unspent funds, if any, returned
by the States, State-wise and year-wise;
(c) whether  Government  have
ascertained the reasons for failure of the
concerned State(s) to utilise the funds;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, reasons therefor?
Urban Infrastructure Development
Scheme
†*3. DR. CHHATTRAPAL SINGH
LODHA:
PROF. R.B.S. VARMA:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to include some cities under the Urban
Infrastructure Development Scheme for
small and medium towns for their
beautification and renovation;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the amount allotted for this
purpose?

2
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Reduction  of  seats  in  Andhra
Pradesh
*4. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that AICTE has
reduced 1,220 MCA seats and about 4,000
Engineering seats in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the academic year from which the
reduction would be operational?
Regularization of illegal colonies in
Delhi
*5. SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI K. B. KRISHNA  MURTHY:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Chief
Minister of Delhi has urged upon the
Central Government to regularize illegally
constructed colony viz. Sainik Farms;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c) Government's policy for
regularizing illegal colonies/constructions in
Delhi?
Setting up of FM radio stations
*6. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government propose to
allow around 330 private radio stations in
the near future;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how far this would help in generating
additional employment opportunities?
Development of National Capital
Region
*7. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
in the last meeting of the National Capital
Regional Planning Board, development of
another new township-Shahjahanpur,
Neemra and Behror in Rajasthan was
considered;
(b) if so, whether the NCR Board have
adequate financial resources to provide
necessary infrastructure facilities to this
new township;
(c) whether NCR is aware that its
commitment for provision of Ganga-water
supply to six Trans-Hindon colonies of
Ghaziabad, like Suryanagar, Ramprastha,
etc. has not been fulfilled due to lack of
financial resources; and
(d) if so, the reasons for not giving
priority to the existing commitments
instead of taking up new liabilities?
Reservation on religious basis
†*8. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken a
decision to implement the reservation
policy in the sphere of education on the
basis of religion;

3
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the facts in this regard; and
(c) the religions identified for reservation
and the institutes approved for the
purpose?
Housing schemes in Maharashtra
*9. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of URBAN EMPLOYMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the schemes and policies of HUDCO
for resolving housing problem in various
parts of the country;
(b) the details and the number of
HUDCO housing projects completed in
Maharashtra during the last three years;
(c) whether there are any projects under
HUDCO's consideration to resolve the
housing problem in the State of
Maharashtra; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Review of laws relating to women
†*10. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the date on which the last review of
the laws relating to women were carried
out; and
(b) the details of the laws covered under
this review alongwith the outcome thereof?
Fast Track Courts
*11. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to run 1560 Fast Track Courts for the next
five years;
(b) whether the Fast Track Courts
would continue to function under the
present arrangement and would entail an
outgo of Rs. 509 crore over five years
beginning from April 1, 2005; and
(c) if so, to what extent these Fast Track
Courts have been helpful in reducing the
burden of long pending cases in the High
Courts?
Child education
*12. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to take over the responsibility of education
to all the children of age group six to
fourteen years irrespective of the financial
capability of their parents;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the manner in which hundred
per  cent education would become possible?
Performance of Government Schools
*13. SHRIMATI  JAYA BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have assessed
the overall results of CBSE, both of 10th
and 12th class;
(b) if so, what has been the performance
of the Government Schools vis-a-vis the
public schools in Delhi, other metros and
rural areas on the other hand; and
(c) whether  Government  are
contemplating any corrective action in light
of the assessment to improve performance
of the Government schools?

4
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Prohibition of dowry
†*14. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI JANARDAN DWIVEDI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Supreme Court has
made a suggestion to Government to make
such a provision which would make it
mandatory for all male Government
employees to furnish a statement on
whether they have accepted dowry and if
so, the details thereof;
(b) whether Government would make
any such provision for the common people
also so that the evil practice of dowry may
be eradicated;
(c) if so, by when; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Metro rail services
*15. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal
has been formulated to make metro rail a
part of the public transport system for all
major  cities  having a population of over
50 lakhs; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
an outline of the plan if any, drawn up, for
execution over the next ten years, the States
which have opted for and the cities
identified for creating the metro
infrastructure and the pattern of funding
evolved therefor?
National Urban Renewal Mission
*16. DR. KARAN SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of  URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether National Urban Renewal
Mission, covering seven mega  cities, 30
smaller cities and other important urban
centres, would give a major boost to social
housing and encourage the States to address
the issues of repeal of the Urban Land
Ceiling  Act, the Rent Control Act and
reduction in rates of stamp duty;
(b) if so,  whether  this proposal has
been submitted to Government for its
approval;
(c) if so, to what extent these proposals
have given a boost to housing in the country;
and
(d) whether National Urban Renewal
Mission has been one of the most
important features of development of these
proposed cities?
Vacant shops under Directorate of
Estates
*17. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRIMATI  AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of  URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the shops  belonging to
Directorate of Estates lying vacant in New
Delhi as on date indicating their reserve
prices and since when these are lying vacant
alongwith the reasons therefor;
(b) whether Government have any
policy  to  allot  shop  to  the   retired
Government employees on concessional
rates and if not, the reasons therefor; and

5
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether there is any proposal to
formulate such a policy as in the case of
residential accommodation?
Backward classes among minorities
*18. SHRI BALAWANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of  SOCIAL
JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of backward class people
among minorities indicating the reasons for
their backwardness;
(b) the remedial measures taken by
Government for eradication of their
backwardness; and
(c) whether Government would keep in
mind these points while providing
reservation to the minorities?
Review of Tenth Five Year Plan by
UGC
†*19. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
University Grants Commission has
completed a review of the Tenth Five Year
Plan;
(b) if so, when was it completed and
the period of the plan which was included
in the review;
(c) the facts regarding achievements of
the targets set under the plan;
(d) whether any recommendations have
been made regarding improvement in its
implementation in future; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Ban on showing of film
†*20. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of  INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it  is  a  fact  that  after  a
strong  protest  the   showing  of  "Jo  Bole
So Nihal" film had been stopped in a
number of  States;
(b) if  so,  the  names  of  such  States;
and
(c) the reasons for not imposing a ban
on showing of this film anticipating a strong
protest thereto?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 19th July, 2005 Secretary-General.

1
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the July 25, 2005/Sravana 3, 1927 (Saka)
————
 (Ministries: Culture; Development of North Eastern Region; Heavy Industries
and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development; Information
and Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Parliamentary Affairs;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Urban
Development; Urban Employment and Poverty Alleviation)
Total number of questions —98
Preservation of art objects
1. SHRI MANOJ BHATTACHARYA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Comptroller and Auditor
General of India has in his Audit Report
ending the 31st March, 2004 (no-4 of 2005)
has adversely commented on the lack of
any proper standard or norms for acquiring,
collecting and preserving art objects in the
Indian Museum, Victoria Memorial and
Asiatic Society in Kolkata;
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether it is also a fact that security
system in these institutions is inadequate
and leaves much to be desired; and
(d) if so, the steps proposed to be taken
to address these shortcomings?
Buddhist stupas in Orissa
2. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN PANY:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during the
recent excavations in Orissa, ASI has
discovered Buddhist stupas;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the time-period to which these
stupas belong to and whether such
structural plans are similar to ones seen at
Sarnath, bihar?
World Heritage Site
3. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN PANY:
SHRI B. J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Bhubaneswar
is proposed to be declared a World Heritage
City;
(b) if so, the details of the
recommendations made by the ASI to the
UNESCO for award of such status;
(c) whether the ASI has also
recommended other sites for WHS status
in the State; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

2
Deterioration of Konark Temple
4. SHRI JANARDAN DWIVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI MANOJ
 BHATTACHARYA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the structure of Konark
Temple and its magnificent celestial chariot
and stone sculpture is fast turning into a
colossal ruin;
(b) whether it is also a fact that 25 per
cent of its sculptural embellishment etched
on inert stones, have been defaced by
erosion and lost forever;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons for neglecting maintenance of the
temple; and
(d) the steps proposed to be taken to
preserve the heritage of this temple?
Seepage in Mahabodhi Temple
5. SHRI JANARDAN DWIVEDI: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether water seepage damaged even
the flagship Mahabodhi Temple;
(b) if so, whether condition of
Mahabodhi Temple and its complex needs
superficial repairs;
(c) whether maintenance of this temple
has been neglected by ASI/Nagar
Panchayat/Bodhgaya Temple Management
Committee/HUDCO;
(d) whether a plan was prepared by
HUDCO to revamp the temple;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and if not,
the reasons for the delay; and
(f) the steps taken by Government to
maintain the temple properly?
Heritages of the world
†6. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether some places of historical
and cultural importance have been included
in the list of hundred world heritages, of
the world which are on the verge of ruin for
2006 by World Monument Fund;
(b) whether Government are taking any
initiatives in cooperation with the World
Monument Fund for maintenance,
protection and management for these
heritages;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether these heritages can be
renovated and given a new look with
Government's assistance?
Encroachments in World Heritage
Sites
†7. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the World Heritage Sites
in the country which are being encroached
upon or having a risk of their encroachment;
and
(b) the steps being taken or proposed
to be taken by Government to stop and
remove such encroachments from the
surroundings of these sites or monuments?
National Library for Ancient
Scriptures
8. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up a National Library for the Ancient
Scriptures and Vedic Religion at
Kanchipuram in Tamil Nadu in view of its
importance;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

3
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when it is likely to be set up?
National Heritage Sites Commission
9. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry proposes to
form a National Heritage Sites Commission
to preserve the heritage sites in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the mandate proposed to be given to
the Commission?
Central Public Sector Undertakings
10. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will the
Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES AND
PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of the Central Public
Sector Undertakings under the
administrative control of his Ministry
functioning at present in the various States
alongwith the location and headquarters
thereof;
(b) the details of the investment made
by Government in each undertaking;
(c) the details of such undertakings
which are running in profit, losses/sick etc.;
and
(d) Government's reaction thereto?
Bharat Wagon and Engineering Co.
Ltd.
†11. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that two units of
Bharat Wagon and Engineering Co. Ltd.
situated at Bihar have resumed functioning
on receiving order from Railways to make
wagons;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps Government are taking for
smooth functioning of both the units?
Pension/Gratuity to employees of
Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti
12. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
introduce Pension-cum-Gratuity Scheme
for employees of the Navodaya Vidyalaya
Samiti;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the action taken so far;
(c) if not, the reason therefor; and
(d) the action, if any, taken for
introduction of gratuity for the teachers,
Vice-Principals and Principals of the
Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti?
Non-implementation of quota norms
for underprivileged
13. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that public
schools, to whom DDA had provided land,
are not abiding by the quota norms of
providing 25 per cent seats to
underprivileged;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what action has been initiated against
those public schools, which had been
served with show cause notices?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

4
Appointments of Vice-Chancellors
14. SHRI C.
RAMACHANDRAIAH:
SHRI MANOJ
BHATTACHARYA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether of late there has been a
perceptible decline in quality of the
incumbents appointed as Vice-
Chancellors in the Universities
including the Central Universities;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken to ensure
selection of the best persons with
distinction and eminence so as to create
public confidence in the academic
standards of the universities?
Misuse of Delhi University logo
15. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Delhi
University logo is being used
frequently on various items at sale in
the Delhi University's utility centre;
(b) whether use of the logo is illegal
as per the Delhi University Act; and
(c) if so, the action taken or
proposed to be taken in this regard?
Private National Curriculum
Framework, 2005
16. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Private National
Curriculum Framework, 2005 seeks to draw
out creativity, eliminate airtight
compartmentalization of subject, make
education more relevant and provide
avenues for greater participation of
Panchayati Raj institutions and civil society
groups in making it a tool for social change;
(b) if so, whether there is a renewed
attempt also to implement three language
formula, recognizing mother tongue
including tribal languages, as best medium
of instruction;
(c) if so, whether all these suggestions
have been recommended to Government;
and
(d) what are the steps being taken to
implement them?
Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya
Yojna
17. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of schools opened under
the Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya
Yojna for girls belonging to SC/ST/OBC
and minorities, State-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
had approved opening of 720 new schools
under this scheme in 2004-05;
(c) if so, the number of schools
Government have been able to open during
2004-05, State-wise and district-wise with
a particular reference to Andhra Pradesh;
and
(d) the number of schools Government
are going to open during the current year?

5
Opening of Kendriya Vidyalayas
†18. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
 SHRI JANARDAN DWIVEDI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Department-related Parliamentary Standing
Committee on Human Resource
Development has suggested that more and
more Kendriya Vidyalayas should be
opened and their infrastructural structure
should be improved alongwith
development and improvement in their
quality;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c) by when Government would take a
final decision in this regard?
Cost of higher education
†19. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
 DR. MURLI MANOHAR JOSHI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a suggestion
has been given by the Planning Commission
to make higher education more expensive;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard;
(c) the rationale given for making the
education more expensive; and
(d) the decision taken by Government
in this regard?
Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan
†20. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER SINGH
MAJITHA:
 DR. MURLI MANOHAR JOSHI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 'Sarva Shiksha
Abhiyan' had been started in 1999 for
providing education to near about 192
million children who were not going to
schools;
(b) if so, the amount allocated under
this campaign till the year 2004-05;
(c) the amount out of the above which
has been utilised till March, 2005; and
(d) the States where utilisation is less
than 50 per cent of the allocated amount
during above period?
Mass Education till Class XII
21. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to treat education upto class XII as mass
education;
(b) if so, the work-plan to turn it
account; and
(c) if not, what else is the status of mass
education in the future target?
Facilities in Government schools
22. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken any
steps to provide better educational facilities
particularly in the Government schools
where most of the students belong to the
families which are unable to afford expenses
of education;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

6
Massive shortfall of teachers
23. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there would
be a massive shortfall of teachers against
the increasing demand of teachers in various
parts of the country;
(b) if so, the remedial measures
Government propose to meet the situation;
and
(c) the details of the steps taken or
proposed to be taken to accelerate teachers
training programmes both for the domestic
and international purposes?
Recounting and revaluation of answer
sheets by CBSE
24. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether only recounting of marks,
and not revaluation of answer sheets of the
candidates appearing in CBSE Board
examinations is allowed;
(b) whether, for the sake of
transparency and as proof of there being
no error in the course of evaluation and
computation of marks in the answer sheets,
data entry and issue of marks cards, etc.,
certain State School Boards furnish photo
copies of the answer sheets to the students
after undertaking revaluation at their
request;
(c) if so, whether CBSE would also
adopt the same practice; and
(d) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Monitoring of textbooks
25. SHRI R.K. ANAND: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the schools
run by the religious and social institutions
contain communal propaganda material;
(b) whether there is any national body
to monitor textbook materials produced
across the country; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Kendriya Vidyalayas
†26. PROF. R.B.S. VARMA: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of the Kendriya
Vidyalayas permitted to be opened by
Government during the last three years;
(b) the number of the Vidyalayas out of
the above which have started operations;
(c) by when the remaining Vidyalayas
would became operational;
(d) whether it is a fact that several
Vidyalayas have been closed during last
three years; and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor?
Introduction of computer education
27. SHRI T. R. ZELIANG: Will the
